scope: Independent, source-grounded reconstruction of software architecture’s structures, interaction/quality reasoning, descriptions, decisions, evaluation, conformance and revision, including documented contemporary translations and criticism. The population is the registered candidate set after examination, not every proposition in every publication.
scope_boundaries: No requester repositories, prior Evolved packets or sibling research consulted.
Architecture intersects but does not annex enterprise, hardware, systems or organisational architecture.
Program families and maintenance are studied only where they establish architecture mechanisms, history or interface obligations; sibling conclusions are not supplied.
This is an explicit bounded interpretive study, not an exhaustive systematic bibliometric review or a meta-analysis.
Normative clauses not read, current vendor prices/quotas not checked, and inaccessible monographs/editions do not support detailed claims.
External legal/compliance authority is not inferred from architectural methods.
evidence_limits: The evolved label and complete composition are analytical, not a recognised school or an independently validated intervention.
All candidates/families were examined, but access limits and unsettled questions remain; full normative standard clauses and selected original monographs were not read.
Source counts are not counts of independent studies. Shared programmes, benchmark reuse and survey/dataset overlap are recorded.
Formal guarantees are model-relative. Comparative, field and historical evidence have distinct roles; no pooled confidence or universal effect estimate is claimed.
ESA-060 and four composition obligations remain examined and unresolved.

checks.substantive_review: Source/edition/access distinctions, empirical denominators, formal assumptions, criticism-changing dispositions, domain models, non-serial composition, alternative configurations, all intakes and analytical/published cases reviewed before freeze. This is the authoring run’s adversarial review, not an independent external reviewer.
checks.check_limit: Checks establish consistency, required structure and link integrity. Substantive source reading and judgement are research work, not proved by schema validation.
checks.archive_verification_protocol: After manifest inclusion: close and reopen ZIP, test CRC/integrity, require exactly the eight payloads plus this manifest, recalculate all payload exact-byte sizes/SHA-256, and verify a fresh extraction. Results are published in the external verification receipt.
